privileged_credentials_vaulted.title: Privileged Credentials Vaulted
privileged_credentials_vaulted.description: All human and non-human privileged credentials (admin passwords, root/DB keys, service-account secrets, API keys, SSH keys, tokens) are stored exclusively in a central encrypted vault, with applications fetching them at runtime rather than holding standing copies.

credential_rotation_enforced.title: Credential Rotation Enforced
credential_rotation_enforced.description: Automatic credential rotation is enforced on a recurring cycle, including rotate-after-checkin one-time-use handling for high-value accounts.

credential_rotation_max_days.title: Maximum Credential Rotation Interval (days)
credential_rotation_max_days.description: Maximum number of days a privileged credential may remain valid before automatic rotation; a hardened configuration keeps this within a 30-90 day window (<= 90).

secrets_in_secret_manager_not_repo.title: Secrets Resolved From Vault, Not Hardcoded
secrets_in_secret_manager_not_repo.description: No privileged credentials or secrets are hardcoded in source code or configuration files; secrets are resolved from the vault at runtime.

vault_at_rest_encryption_strength.title: Vault At-Rest Encryption Strength
vault_at_rest_encryption_strength.description: Encryption algorithm/strength protecting the vault contents at rest; the secure state is AES_256.

no_standing_admin_privileges_jit_require.title: JIT Elevation With Zero Standing Privilege
no_standing_admin_privileges_jit_require.description: Elevated privileges are granted just-in-time on request for a bounded task window and automatically revoked at task end or timeout, and no identity holds permanent membership in highly-privileged groups (Domain Admins, root, cloud Owner). The load-bearing control: admins carry no standing elevation between tasks, eliminating the standing-admin surface escalation abuse depends on.

max_elevation_window_hours.title: Maximum JIT Elevation Window (hours)
max_elevation_window_hours.description: Maximum lifetime in hours of a granted just-in-time elevation before automatic revocation. A bounded window (<=4h) caps the time any elevated session can be abused.

periodic_privilege_recertification.title: Privileged Access Recertified
periodic_privilege_recertification.description: Eligibility for privileged-access elevation is periodically recertified (e.g. quarterly) so stale or no-longer-needed entitlements are removed, keeping the JIT eligibility set scoped to current least-privilege need. Also covers periodic recertification and auto-revoke-on-expiry of standing grants in the approval workflow.

bastion_mediates_all_admin_access.title: All Admin Access Brokered, No Bypass Path
bastion_mediates_all_admin_access.description: All RDP/SSH/DB/cloud-CLI admin access is proxied through a central PAM gateway/jump host that enforces protocol and command filtering, AND direct-to-target admin network paths are blocked by segmentation so the broker cannot be bypassed. True when every privileged session is mediated by the broker and no out-of-band path to the target's management ports exists.

phishing_resistant_authenticator_require.title: Phishing-Resistant Authenticator Required
phishing_resistant_authenticator_require.description: The broker requires phishing-resistant MFA (PIV/FIDO2/WebAuthn at AAL2/AAL3) bound per-user before any session begins, and no SMS/OTP/push fallback authenticators are permitted. True when only hardware-bound, origin-bound authenticators are accepted, defeating AiTM/token-replay downgrade.

provisioning_requires_approval.title: Governed Privileged-Grant Approval Workflow
provisioning_requires_approval.description: Every privileged grant requires a formal request carrying business justification routed through a tiered approval workflow before access is provisioned, and access auto-revokes on expiry. The assessor verifies a documented, enforced (not advisory) request-and-approve gate governs all privileged grants.

segregation_of_duties_enforced.title: Separation of Duties on Approval Path
segregation_of_duties_enforced.description: Separation of duties is enforced on the approval path per AC-5: the requester cannot approve their own privileged grant, and the security-admin role is separated from the audit role. The assessor confirms the workflow rejects self-approval and that approval and oversight responsibilities sit with distinct principals.

break_glass_dual_control_enforced.title: Break-Glass Dual-Control Enforced
break_glass_dual_control_enforced.description: Emergency break-glass access is pre-defined and requires dual-control (two-person) activation, fires immediate alerts on use, is fully recorded, and mandates post-use review. Converts ungoverned shared emergency credentials into a governed, auditable path.

break_glass_max_window_hours.title: Maximum Break-Glass Window (hours)
break_glass_max_window_hours.description: Maximum lifetime in hours of a break-glass emergency access grant before it auto-expires. A short, bounded window (e.g. <= 4h) is the secure state; the grant cannot persist beyond it.

dedicated_attributable_admin_accounts_en.title: Dedicated, Attributable Admin Accounts
dedicated_attributable_admin_accounts_en.description: Privileged actions run only from dedicated, individually-attributable admin accounts — never the operator's daily-use account and never a shared/generic admin account — so every privileged action maps to exactly one identifiable human. Folds the no-shared-admin-accounts requirement.

service_account_inventory_governed.title: Privileged & Service Account Discovery
service_account_inventory_governed.description: All privileged and service accounts across Windows/Unix/DB/cloud/network estates are auto-discovered on at least a monthly cadence, with newly-created privileged accounts detected within 24-48h, so rogue or orphaned admin accounts are surfaced rather than persisting unseen.

dormant_account_disable_window_days.title: Dormant Admin Account Disable Window (days)
dormant_account_disable_window_days.description: Maximum bounded inactivity window, in days, after which a dormant privileged account is auto-disabled. Secure when <=45 days; a large or unbounded value leaves dormant accounts available for takeover.

offboarding_credential_revocation_enforc.title: Same-Day Departure Access Revocation
offboarding_credential_revocation_enforc.description: Privileged access for a departing person is revoked same-day on departure, closing the gap where an offboarded human's admin account could be retained or hijacked for persistence.

privileged_access_via_pam_with_session_r.title: Privileged Session Recording Enabled
privileged_access_via_pam_with_session_r.description: Every privileged session is fully recorded (screen, keystroke, and command capture) so privileged activity is reconstructable and non-repudiable.

identity_access_audit_logging_enabled.title: Privileged Activity Audit Logged
identity_access_audit_logging_enabled.description: Every privileged action is logged with full context to centralized, externally-stored audit logs that the recorded admin cannot alter or delete (AU-9 separation of audit administration from the audited).

audit_log_tamper_evident.title: Audit Logs Tamper-Evident
audit_log_tamper_evident.description: Privileged audit/session logs are signed or otherwise immutable so any alteration or deletion is detectable, preserving non-repudiation of privileged misuse.

log_retention_days.title: Privileged Log Retention (days)
log_retention_days.description: Retention period in days for privileged session recordings and audit logs; >=90 days ensures sufficient history for forensic reconstruction and persistence detection.

privileged_session_anomaly_monitoring.title: Privileged Session Anomaly Monitoring
privileged_session_anomaly_monitoring.description: Privileged sessions/accounts are monitored in real time for atypical usage (off-hours activity, mass account creation, unusual targets) with alerting, detecting account-manipulation persistence.

min_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version (Broker Transport)
min_tls_version.description: Minimum TLS protocol version negotiated on connections to the PAM broker and between broker and vault. A secure value (TLS1.2 or TLS1.3) means SSLv3 and early-TLS are disabled, preventing on-path downgrade and interception of brokered credentials.

cipher_suites_strong_only.title: Strong Cipher Suites Only
cipher_suites_strong_only.description: Interpreted boolean: true when only strong AEAD cipher suites with ECDHE forward secrecy are permitted and weak suites (NULL/RC4/MD5/export) are disabled on the broker transport. Modeled as a boolean to avoid substring polarity traps on composite cipher strings.

server_certificate_validated.title: Broker Certificate Validated
server_certificate_validated.description: The broker and broker-to-vault TLS endpoints present and validate server certificates (chain, hostname, expiry), preventing an adjacent attacker from impersonating the broker or vault on the brokered session.
